test_title: PYST 60: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends Sarthi, Pari, Vani, Kabir, Arshi, and Kamal, are sitting in a circle. All of them are facing the centre. Sarthi sits second to the left of Pari. Vani sits third to the right of Kabir. Arshi is an immediate neighbour of Pari and Kabir. Who sits fourth to the left of Vani?
solution:
Six friends** Sarthi, Pari, Vani, Kabir, Arshi, and Kamal**, are sitting in a circle. All of them are facing the centre.

1. Sarthi sits second to the left of Pari.

2. Arshi is an immediate neighbour of Pari and Kabir.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03df36d283eec108719420b7ed335a68104c7c635b4d443611c82459165b864b.png] 

3. Vani sits third to the right of Kabir.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc007693e6197d65dd71a5fcc705d721a721a59ccc77c6d2a0925e13779afdc3.png] 

Kamal, the only person left will occupy the vacant position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9947d0528c78f122f0d7dad7bea771a4a938e74d25aa914695ff458061c37780.png] 

Clearly, Arshi sits fourth to the left of Vani.

Hence, '**Arshi**' is the correct answer.
